description: Fetch a Hugging Face collection by user/slug (e.g. deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4) or full URL https://huggingface.co/collections/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4. Returns the collection title, description, author, upvotes, last updated time, and all items (models, datasets, Spaces, papers, buckets) with per-item type, id, url, likes, and downloads. No login required.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Collection as user/slug (e.g. deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4) or full URL https://huggingface.co/collections/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4. 收藏集标识：user/slug 或完整 URL 两种形式均接受，命令会自动解析出 user/slug。
